items.duty_text: Establish a system through which members of the public or nonprofit organizations may rectify erroneous criminal records, including providing direct access to state and local agencies responsible for such records.
Take all measures necessary to ensure that the public is aware of the system for rectifying erroneous criminal records.

Take all practicable measures to ensure the accuracy and consistency of criminal records between responsible state and local agencies, identify the root causes of erroneous criminal records, and propose permanent solutions to address those causes.
Publish the annual report regarding actions taken pursuant to this section on the office’s website.
items.deadline_text: Within 30 days of the beginning of each calendar year, commencing in 2018

observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Ensure that the records of outstanding criminal warrants maintained by the New York city police department are consistent with the records of the office of court administration.
Take all measures necessary to facilitate the reduction of outstanding criminal warrants, including organizing and implementing events for the purpose of vacating criminal warrants.
Establish a means for members of the public to rectify inaccurate warrants.

Provide all contracted organizations providing reentry or alternatives-to-incarceration services with information regarding civil service exams administered by the department of citywide administrative services and information regarding the appointment process.

Immediately forward all civil service exam announcements to all contracted organizations providing reentry or alternatives-to-incarceration services upon receipt of information about those exams from the department of citywide administrative services.

Permanently store the information required pursuant to paragraphs 34 through 37, make it accessible through the city’s open data web portal, and provide it in a format permitting automated processing.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.
